summary: IDF struck five Hamas militants in northern Gaza, killing a Nukhba operative, while simultaneously attacking a Hezbollah vehicle in southern Lebanon and conducting artillery shelling across multiple Lebanese villages. Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral processions continue with massive gatherings and regional commemorations in Tehran, Qom, and Najaf. Hezbollah has severed direct communication channels with the Lebanese presidency following a framework agreement.
key_points: IDF killed Hamas Nukhba operative Hazifa Hussein Abdullah Al-Hawajri in northern Gaza while targeting underground terror infrastructure reconstruction. (Source: @New_security8200/202244)
IDF attacked a vehicle carrying Hezbollah militants near Al-Aqida in southern Lebanon as they approached the security zone. (Source: @inon_yttach/9288)
Artillery shelling reported in Lebanese villages Kounin, Barashit, and Hula. (Source: @redlinkleb/30293, @redlinkleb/30259, @redlinkleb/30326)
Enemy drone concentration observed in Hannaouiyeh, southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374896)
Khamenei funeral prayer held at Jamkaran Mosque led by Ayatollah Javadi Amoli, procession toward Imam Reza shrine. (Source: @SharghDaily/170281)
Khamenei's coffin arrived in Qom after Tehran funeral; Najaf prepares farewell ceremony. (Source: @asafroz/51048, @presstv/197246)
Hezbollah cut all direct communication channels with Lebanese presidency since framework agreement signing. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374894)
Netanyahu asked Trump to curb Erdogan, expressing concern over US weapons sales modernizing Turkish air force. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374904)

sections.executive_summary: IDF conducted simultaneous strikes in Gaza and Lebanon, eliminating a senior Hamas operative in Jabalia and targeting Hezbollah militants near the security zone, while artillery fire hit multiple southern Lebanese villages. Iran's leadership transition unfolds with Khamenei's multi-city funeral processions drawing massive crowds and regional commemorations in Najaf. Hezbollah's communications cutoff with Beirut signals potential escalation in Lebanese internal dynamics amid ongoing Israeli military pressure.

sections.threat_assessment: Simultaneous Israeli kinetic operations in Gaza and Lebanon indicate a coordinated campaign to degrade Hamas reconstruction and enforce Lebanese buffer zones. Hezbollah's communications cutoff with Beirut suggests either strategic disengagement or preparation for escalation, while Iranian funeral mobilizations demonstrate regime cohesion despite leadership transition. The Netanyahu-Trump-Erdogan triangle introduces new friction in NATO's southern flank, potentially complicating US regional policy.
sections.regional_response: Iraq's Najaf holiday declaration and participation in Khamenei commemorations reflect Baghdad's alignment with Tehran's narrative. Macron's Damascus visit signals European willingness to engage post-Assad Syria, possibly countering Turkish and Iranian influence. Lebanese internal fracture deepens as Hezbollah isolates from state institutions, risking paralysis in security coordination. Gulf states remain notably absent from public messaging, suggesting cautious observation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The precision strike on a named Hamas battalion commander in Jabalia indicates persistent Israeli intelligence penetration despite ceasefire frameworks. Artillery patterns across Kounin, Barashit, and Hula suggest systematic targeting of Hezbollah's southern logistics rather than reactive fire. Ukrainian long-range drone strike on Omsk (2,400 km) demonstrates expanding kinetic reach that could theoretically threaten Iranian infrastructure, a development likely noted in Tehran's threat calculus.
